description: Send one file in several calls when it is too big for a single tool call. Last resort: first try add_files with encoding:'gzip+base64' (about 250 KB of text in one call), begin_deploy's uploadUrl (one 100 MB tar POST) or deploy_from_url (public archive URL). When chunking, gzip+base64 each chunk too, mark the first with isFirst and the last with isLast, and send chunks of one file one after another: parallel chunks corrupt it. After a transport error, do not resend the chunk blindly: restart the file from its first chunk (isFirst truncates it).

content.description: This chunk's bytes, as UTF-8 text or encoded per encoding. Chunk size is limited by your client's tool-output budget, not by the server: about 80 KB of base64 (60 KB raw) per chunk is a safe upper bound.

encoding.description: utf8 (default), base64 (binary), or gzip+base64 (gzip this chunk locally; the server gunzips before appending). Set per chunk.

expectedByteOffset.description: Optional check: where this chunk starts in the assembled file (0 for the first chunk, else the decoded bytes sent so far). A mismatch fails with MISALIGNED_CHUNK before writing, which catches base64 split mid-byte.

isFirst.description: True on the first chunk of a file: truncates any staged file at this path and creates parent directories.

isLast.description: True on the final chunk: returns the assembled file size and refreshes the session file count.

path.description: Path relative to the site root, e.g. 'portaal-admin.html'. Same rules as add_files.

name: add_file_chunk

bytesWritten.description: Decoded bytes written by THIS chunk.

fileSize.description: Assembled file size on the pod after this chunk. Returned only when isLast=true so the caller can verify the concat succeeded.

remainingBudget.description: Bytes still available before hitting the 500 MB cap.

totalBytes.description: Session-wide cumulative bytes across all add_files / add_file_chunk calls.

totalFiles.description: Session-wide file count after this chunk. Returned only when isLast=true.

title: Append one chunk of a single file to a staging session
